summary: Modules default to /usr/bin/python, which often doesn't exist on BSD, so set ansible_python_interpreter, such as /usr/local/bin/python on FreeBSD and /usr/local/bin/python3 on OpenBSD.
questions: Where is Python on FreeBSD for Ansible?
How do I set the Python path for OpenBSD hosts?

answer_card.title: Set the Python interpreter on BSD
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[freebsd:vars]
ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/local/bin/python
[openbsd:vars]
ansible_python_interpreter=/usr/local/bin/python3
```
Modules default to `/usr/bin/python`, which BSD may not have.
